Cost borne per $1M of raw pool volume by the people who pay it (same as the take): traders on every swap; a two-hop route through the token pays 2x.

LP round trip on the fee-bearing side (deposit, later withdraw), as a fraction of the token-side amount: about 2 x rate.

| transfer fee | LP round-trip cost on a $10k position (half in the token) | turnover (volume / TVL) needed to repay it if LPs keep an illustrative 25 bps of each swap |
|---|---|---|
| 10 bps | $10.00 | 0.4x TVL over the holding period |
| 30 bps | $30.00 | 1.2x TVL over the holding period |
| 50 bps | $50.00 | 2.0x TVL over the holding period |
| 100 bps | $100 | 4.0x TVL over the holding period |

Harvest cost (permissionless HarvestWithheldTokensToMint, one signature per transaction):
